channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Inside Democrats’ Secret Effort to Stack Alaska’s Midterm Ballot With Another Dan Sullivan
item.description: Operatives aligned with Mary Peltola, the Democratic nominee for Senate, spent months recruiting candidates to peel votes from Senator Dan Sullivan, the Republican.

item.title: NPR: Dolores Huerta, influential labor leader, feminist and civil rights icon, dies at 96
item.description: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase "Sí, se puede!" that became a widespread rallying cry.

item.description: The author believes we are at a turning point as a species – and even in the shadow of big tech it’s up to us how we want to proceed ‘I am a storyteller by trade,” writes Jeanette Winterson on the first page of her 2021…

item.title: Ars Technica: A hidden ocean change near Antarctica could have global consequences

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Please Let the Internet Die
item.description: Online spaces are captured by oligarchs and saturated with slop—and they’re exacerbating humanity’s worst impulses. It’s time to start over.

item.title: WIRED Science: AI Emergency Alerts Are Coming. Humans Might Not Be Ready
item.description: Human beings struggle with emergency communication. Chatbots can help—if people take them seriously.

item.title: WIRED Business: Should AI Decide Your Court Case? This Judge Says Yes
item.description: One of England’s top judges, Geoffrey Vos, believes that AI could adjudicate plenty of civil cases. The question, he says, is where the line should be drawn.

item.title: The New Yorker: Can Democrats Win Back Labor?
item.description: Two years ago, Sherrod Brown, who built his career as an avatar of blue-collar frustration, lost his Senate seat in Ohio as working-class voters defected to Trump. Now he and his party are looking to make up lost ground.

item.description: The ceiling is shiny, the organ is pink, and the officiants have included a goth Elvis and John Waters.
